title: 자기소개
intro: OPIc 인터뷰의 첫 질문은 거의 항상 'Please tell me a little bit about yourself.'이고, 이어서 성격·여가, 평일 일과, 직업·회사 질문이 나올 수 있습니다. 답변은 '분당 IT 회사 20년차 소프트웨어 개발자, 개발팀 리드, 회사에서 차로 20분 거리 아파트에서 가족(아이 둘)과 거주'라는 하나의 페르소나로 통일하세요. 여기서 말한 집·가족·조깅·영화의 밤·동료 Minho가 이후 모든 주제에 그대로 다시 나오므로, 자기소개가 전체 시험의 뼈대가 됩니다.
strategy: 답변 흐름: 'Okay, let me tell you about myself.' → 이름·직업(분당 IT 회사 개발자 20년차) → 사는 곳·가족 → 바쁜 일상 한 줄 → 여가(가족 시간, 영화) → 'Yeah, that's a short introduction about myself.' 마무리
짧고 쉬운 문장으로 말하세요. 'pretty busy', 'spending time with my family'처럼 실제 말하는 표현이 어려운 단어보다 훨씬 자연스럽습니다.
배우자는 성별 단어 없이 'my family', 'we', 'the four of us'로, 아이는 'my son', 'my daughter', 'my kids'로 말하면 됩니다.
IH 이상은 팀 리드 역할, 금요일 재택, 탄천 조깅, 금요일 가족 영화의 밤 같은 디테일과 '왜 좋은지' 이유를 한두 문장씩 더하세요.

expressions.en: Okay, let me tell you about myself.
expressions.note: 자기소개 시작 문장. 'Sure, I'd love to ~'로 바꿔도 좋아요

expressions.en: I'm currently working at an IT company in Bundang.
expressions.ko: 저는 현재 분당에 있는 IT 회사에서 일하고 있어요.

expressions.en: I've been working there for about 20 years.
expressions.note: have been -ing for + 기간 = ~해 온 지 …

expressions.en: I live with my family in an apartment.
My daily life is pretty busy.
In my free time, I like spending time with my family.
expressions.ko: 여가 시간에는 가족과 시간을 보내는 걸 좋아해요.

expressions.en: I'm in charge of a team of ten developers.
expressions.ko: 저는 개발자 10명으로 된 팀을 맡고 있어요.
expressions.note: be in charge of = ~을 책임지다, 맡다

expressions.en: I'd say I'm a calm and responsible person.
expressions.ko: 저는 차분하고 책임감 있는 사람이라고 생각해요.
expressions.note: I'd say ~ = 성격을 부드럽게 말할 때

expressions.en: I spend most of my day in meetings and code reviews.
expressions.ko: 하루 대부분을 회의와 코드 리뷰로 보내요.

expressions.en: I work from home on Fridays, which is really nice.
expressions.ko: 금요일에는 재택근무를 하는데, 그게 정말 좋아요.
expressions.note: , which ~ = 앞 문장 전체를 받는 관계사

expressions.en: Jogging helps me clear my head after a long day.
expressions.ko: 조깅은 긴 하루 뒤에 머리를 비우는 데 도움이 돼요.

expressions.en: Time really flies — I can't believe it's already been 20 years.
expressions.ko: 시간 정말 빠르네요. 벌써 20년이 됐다니 믿기지 않아요.

expressions.en: No matter how busy I am, I try to have dinner with my kids.
expressions.ko: 아무리 바빠도 아이들과 저녁은 먹으려고 해요.
expressions.note: No matter how + 형용사 + 주어 + 동사 = 아무리 ~해도

expressions.en: Yeah, that's a short introduction about myself.
expressions.ko: 네, 이게 저에 대한 짧은 소개예요.
expressions.note: 마무리 문장. 'So yeah, that's pretty much me.'도 좋아요

questions.en: Let's start the interview now. Please tell me a little bit about yourself.
questions.ko: 이제 인터뷰를 시작하겠습니다. 자기소개를 간단히 해 주세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Okay, let me tell you about myself.' → 이름·직업·근속 연수 → 사는 곳·가족 → 바쁜 일상 → 여가 → 'Yeah, that's a short introduction about myself.' 마무리
IM3 답안은 그대로 외워 두면 어떤 시험에서도 바로 쓸 수 있는 기본 자기소개입니다.
IH·AL은 같은 뼈대에 팀 리드 역할, 아이들 나이, 금요일 영화의 밤 같은 디테일만 덧붙이세요.

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you about myself. My name is Alex. I'm currently working at an IT company in Bundang. I'm a software developer, and I've been working there for about 20 years. I live with my family in an apartment about 20 minutes from my office. My daily life is pretty busy because I usually have a lot of meetings and projects. In my free time, I like spending time with my family or watching movies at home. Yeah, that's a short introduction about myself.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to tell you about myself. My name is Alex, and I'm in my mid-forties. I'm a software developer at an IT company in Bundang, and I've been working there for about 20 years. These days, I lead a development team of ten people, so I have a lot of meetings and code reviews. I live with my family in an apartment about 20 minutes from my office by car. There are four of us, and my kids are in middle school and elementary school. My weekdays are pretty busy, but I try to keep my weekends free for my family. In my free time, I like jogging along the Tancheon trail or watching movies at home. Friday night is our family movie night, and everyone looks forward to it. So yeah, that's a little bit about me.
answers.AL: Okay, let me tell you a little bit about myself. My name is Alex, and I'm in my mid-forties. I studied electronic engineering in college, and right after I graduated, I joined an IT company in Bundang. I'm still there as a software developer, and believe it or not, it's been about 20 years. Time really flies. These days, I lead a team of ten developers, so I spend most of my day in meetings, code reviews, and mentoring new people. It's pretty busy, but I honestly enjoy it, especially watching young developers grow. I live with my family in an apartment that's only 20 minutes from my office, which is a huge plus. My son is in middle school, and my daughter is in elementary school, so our home is never quiet. No matter how busy work gets, I try to have dinner with my kids. When I have free time, I go jogging along the Tancheon trail early in the morning, and on Friday nights, the four of us have a movie night with snacks. That's what keeps me going, and it's the best part of my week. So yeah, that's a short introduction about myself.

보통 회의랑 프로젝트가 많아서 일상이 꽤 바빠요.

네, 이게 제 간단한 자기소개예요.
IH: 그럼요, 기꺼이 제 소개를 해 드릴게요.

요즘은 10명으로 된 개발팀을 이끌고 있어서 회의랑 코드 리뷰가 많아요.

AL: 네, 제 소개를 조금 해 드릴게요.
제 이름은 알렉스이고, 40대 중반이에요.
대학에서 전자공학을 전공했고, 졸업하자마자 분당에 있는 IT 회사에 들어갔어요.
지금도 거기서 소프트웨어 개발자로 일하고 있는데, 믿기 어려우시겠지만 벌써 20년 정도 됐어요.
시간 정말 빨라요.
요즘은 개발자 10명으로 된 팀을 이끌고 있어서, 하루 대부분을 회의하고 코드 리뷰하고 신입들 멘토링하면서 보내요.

회사에서 겨우 20분 거리에 있는 아파트에서 가족과 함께 사는데, 그게 정말 큰 장점이에요.
아들은 중학생이고 딸은 초등학생이라서, 우리 집은 조용할 날이 없어요.
일이 아무리 바빠도 아이들이랑 저녁은 같이 먹으려고 해요.
시간이 날 때는 이른 아침에 탄천 산책로를 따라 조깅을 하고, 금요일 밤에는 네 식구가 간식을 먹으면서 영화의 밤을 보내요.
그게 저를 버티게 해 주는 힘이고, 한 주 중에 제일 좋은 시간이에요.
네, 이게 제 간단한 자기소개예요.

questions.en: Tell me more about yourself. What kind of person are you, and what do you like to do in your free time?
questions.ko: 자신에 대해 좀 더 말해 주세요. 어떤 성격이고, 여가 시간에는 무엇을 하는 걸 좋아하나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Sure, I'd love to talk about that.' → 성격 2가지(차분함, 책임감) → 취미 2~3개와 빈도 → 취미가 주는 느낌 → 'Yeah, that's ~' 마무리
성격은 'I'd say I'm ~'로 부드럽게, 취미는 조깅·영화·음악·카페처럼 뒤 주제와 연결되는 것으로 고르세요.
'about three times a week', 'on Friday nights' 같은 빈도 표현을 꼭 넣으세요.

answers.IM3: Sure, I'd love to talk about that. I think I'm a calm and responsible person. I don't get upset easily, and I always try to keep my promises. In my free time, I like spending time with my family. On Friday nights, we watch movies together at home. I also go jogging along the Tancheon trail about three times a week. And on weekend mornings, I read books at a cafe near my place. Yeah, that's what I'm like.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about that. I'd say I'm a calm and responsible person. I've been a team lead for a while, so people on my team come to me when there's a problem, and I try to stay calm and listen first. My coworker Minho always says I never panic, even before a big deadline. Work can be really stressful, though, so my free time is important to me. I go jogging along the Tancheon trail about three times a week, early in the morning. On Friday nights, my family has a movie night, and we usually watch an action movie or an animated film on Netflix. On weekend mornings, I like reading a book at a cafe with an Americano. These small things really help me relax. Yeah, that's pretty much what I'm like.
answers.AL: Oh, what kind of person am I? Let me think. I'd say I'm a calm and responsible person. I've been leading a development team for years, and when something goes wrong, everyone kind of looks at me, so I've learned to take a deep breath and stay cool. My coworker Minho jokes that nothing can make me panic, not even a server going down at midnight. But to be honest, I do get stressed like anybody else. I just have my own ways of dealing with it, and they work pretty well. First, I go jogging along the Tancheon trail three times a week at six thirty in the morning. Thirty minutes of running really clears my head. Second, my family is my biggest stress reliever. Every Friday night, the four of us have a movie night with popcorn, and my kids get to pick the movie, which usually means an animated film. And on Saturday mornings, I sit in a quiet cafe in my neighborhood with an Americano and a book. Honestly, there's nothing better than that. It's simple, but it really works for me. So yeah, that's pretty much who I am.

IM3: 그럼요, 기꺼이 이야기해 드릴게요.
저는 차분하고 책임감 있는 사람인 것 같아요.
쉽게 화를 내지 않고, 항상 약속을 지키려고 해요.
시간이 날 때는 가족이랑 시간을 보내는 걸 좋아해요.

그리고 일주일에 세 번 정도 탄천 산책로를 따라 조깅도 해요.
또 주말 아침에는 집 근처 카페에서 책을 읽어요.
네, 저는 그런 사람이에요.
IH: 그럼요, 기꺼이 이야기해 드릴게요.
저는 차분하고 책임감 있는 사람이라고 할 수 있어요.
팀장을 한 지 좀 돼서, 문제가 생기면 팀원들이 저한테 오는데, 저는 침착하게 먼저 들어 주려고 해요.
제 동료 민호는 제가 큰 마감을 앞두고도 절대 당황하지 않는다고 늘 말해요.
그래도 일이 정말 스트레스가 많아서, 저한테는 여가 시간이 중요해요.
일주일에 세 번 정도 이른 아침에 탄천 산책로를 따라 조깅을 해요.
금요일 밤에는 가족끼리 영화의 밤을 하는데, 보통 넷플릭스로 액션 영화나 애니메이션을 봐요.
주말 아침에는 카페에서 아메리카노 한 잔이랑 책 읽는 걸 좋아해요.
이런 소소한 것들이 긴장을 푸는 데 정말 도움이 돼요.

AL: 아, 제가 어떤 사람이냐고요?
생각 좀 해 볼게요.
저는 차분하고 책임감 있는 사람이라고 할 수 있어요.
몇 년째 개발팀을 이끌고 있는데, 뭔가 잘못되면 다들 저를 쳐다보는 느낌이라, 심호흡하고 침착하게 있는 법을 배웠어요.
제 동료 민호는 한밤중에 서버가 다운돼도 저는 당황하지 않을 거라고 농담해요.
그런데 솔직히 말하면, 저도 다른 사람들처럼 스트레스를 받아요.
그냥 저만의 해소 방법이 있는데, 그게 꽤 효과가 좋아요.
첫째, 일주일에 세 번 아침 6시 반에 탄천 산책로를 따라 조깅을 해요.
30분 달리고 나면 머리가 정말 맑아져요.

솔직히 그것보다 좋은 건 없어요.
단순하지만 저한테는 정말 잘 맞아요.
네, 저는 대충 그런 사람이에요.

questions.en: Tell me about a typical weekday for you. What do you do from the time you get up until you go to bed?
questions.ko: 평범한 평일 하루에 대해 말해 주세요. 일어나서 잠자리에 들 때까지 무엇을 하나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Okay, let me tell you about my typical weekday.' → 아침(기상·조깅·아침 식사) → 출근(차로 20분) → 회사(회의·코드 리뷰·점심) → 퇴근 후(가족 저녁·숙제) → 취침 → 'Yeah, that's ~' 마무리
시간 순서 연결어 First, Then, After that, In the evening을 쓰면 흐름이 깔끔해요.
금요일은 재택근무라 조금 다르다는 한 줄을 넣으면 IH 이상의 디테일이 됩니다.

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you about my typical weekday. I usually get up at six. Three days a week, I go jogging for about 30 minutes. Then, I have breakfast with my family. I drive to work, and it takes about 20 minutes. I start work at nine. I have a lot of meetings and code reviews during the day. I usually leave the office at seven. After dinner, I help my kids with their homework. I go to bed at around eleven. Yeah, that's my typical weekday.
answers.IH: Okay, let me tell you about my typical weekday. I get up at six every morning. On Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, I go jogging along the Tancheon trail for about 30 minutes. After that, I take a quick shower and have breakfast with my family. It's a little crazy because my kids are always looking for their school bags. I drive to the office at around eight thirty, and it only takes 20 minutes. My workday starts at nine with a team meeting. Then, I spend most of the day reviewing code and helping my team members. I usually have lunch with my coworker Minho. I leave work at around seven and have dinner with my family. After dinner, I check my kids' homework or watch the news. Fridays are a little different because I work from home. Yeah, that's a typical weekday for me.
answers.AL: Okay, let me walk you through a typical weekday. My alarm goes off at six, and three mornings a week, I head out for a 30-minute jog along the Tancheon trail. It's still quiet at that time, and it's the only part of the day that's just for me. When I get back, the house is already noisy. My son is usually half asleep, and my daughter is looking for her socks, so breakfast is a bit chaotic, but I actually love it. I leave home at around eight thirty and drive about 20 minutes to my office near Pangyo. My day officially starts at nine with a short team meeting, and after that, it's basically back-to-back meetings, code reviews, and questions from junior developers. Around noon, I grab lunch with Minho, who's been my coworker for over 15 years, and we chat about anything but work. I try to leave by seven, though it doesn't always work out. In the evening, I have dinner with my family and help my kids with their homework. By eleven, I'm usually in bed. Fridays are easier since I work from home. So yeah, that's what my weekdays look like.

questions.en: You indicated in the survey that you work at a company. Tell me about your job and your company. What do you do, and what is a typical day at work like?
questions.ko: 설문에서 회사에 다닌다고 하셨습니다. 당신의 직업과 회사에 대해 말해 주세요. 무슨 일을 하고, 회사에서의 평범한 하루는 어떤가요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Sure, let me tell you about my job.' → 회사(분당 IT 회사, 판교 쪽 큰 건물 12층) → 직무(개발팀 리드, 팀원 10명, 20년차) → 하루 업무(회의·코드 리뷰·멘토링) → 느낌·이유 → 'Yeah, that's ~' 마무리
'I'm in charge of ~', 'I'm responsible for ~'로 맡은 일을 말하면 직무 설명이 쉬워집니다.
힘든 점 하나와 보람 있는 점 하나를 같이 말하면 IH·AL 수준의 깊이가 생겨요.

answers.IM3: Sure, let me tell you about my job. I work at an IT company in Bundang. Our office is on the 12th floor of a big building near Pangyo. I'm a software developer, and I've worked there for about 20 years. Now I'm the leader of a development team with ten people. My day starts at nine with a team meeting. Then, I review code and help my team members. It's pretty busy, but I like my job. Yeah, that's my job.
answers.IH: Sure, let me tell you about my job. I'm a software developer at an IT company in Bundang. Our office is on the 12th floor of a big building near Pangyo, and it's only a 20-minute drive from my home. I've been with the company for about 20 years, and these days I lead a development team of ten people. A typical day starts at nine with a short team meeting. After that, I spend a lot of time reviewing code and talking with other teams about our projects. I also mentor new developers, which I really enjoy. Lunch is usually with my coworker Minho. The hardest part is that I have so many meetings that I sometimes don't have time to write code myself. But it's really rewarding to see my team grow. Yeah, that's what I do at work.
answers.AL: Sure, let me tell you about my job. I work for an IT company in Bundang, and our office is on the 12th floor of a big glass building near Pangyo. I joined the company right out of college, so I've been there for about 20 years now, which is pretty rare in this industry. I started out as a junior developer writing code all day, but these days I lead a software development team of ten people. My typical day starts at nine with a quick team meeting where we check what everyone's working on. Then, the rest of the day is a mix of code reviews, planning meetings with other teams, and mentoring our new developers. To be honest, I miss coding sometimes, because I spend more time in meetings than in front of my code. But when a junior developer I've been mentoring finally solves a tough problem alone, it makes me really proud. My longtime coworker Minho and I usually grab lunch together and talk about anything but work. On Fridays, I work from home, which gives me a nice break. So yeah, that's pretty much what my job is like.
